prompt: In an anime style illustration, the village market awakens under a pale sky. On the left stands a woman in a blue apron holding a basket of bright oranges. Next to her on the ground sits a striped cat with green eyes, its tail curled neatly around its paws. In the center, an old man with a white beard leans heavily on a wooden cane while wearing a tattered gray coat. He is looking at a young boy in a yellow cap who stands directly opposite him. The boy is pointing eagerly at a stack of woven baskets piled high beside the elder. To the right, a merchant in a purple turban hands a silver coin to a customer dressed in simple brown robes. The customer reaches out with both hands to accept the payment. Behind them, a large clay jar with a cracked rim rests on a wooden crate. There is no modern technology visible in this rustic setting. The soft morning light touches the edges of the stalls, highlighting the dust motes dancing in the air between the figures. The woman in the blue apron glances toward the central pair, her expression calm and observant. The striped cat remains still, watching the exchange with mild curiosity. The wooden cane of the old man casts a long shadow across the cobblestones, anchoring the composition. The woven baskets show intricate patterns of straw and reed. The silver coin gleams faintly as it passes from hand to hand. The cracked rim of the clay jar suggests age and frequent use. The scene captures a quiet moment of daily life before the full bustle of the day begins.
